speaker: radio#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode09
text: This is Ira Flatow and you're listening to NPR's Science Friday. Joining us today by phone from his office in Pasadena, California is Dr. Sheldon Cooper.

speaker: barry_kripke
text: Oh, this is going to be a wiot.

speaker: radio#unknown#TheBigBangTheory.Season03.Episode09
text: Thanks for being with us today, Dr. Cooper.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: My pleasure, Ira.

speaker: ira_flatow
text: Now, let's talk about magnetic monopoles. Can you explain to our audience just what a monopole is?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Of course. First, consider an ordinary magnet which has, as even the most uneducated in your audience must know, two poles, a north and south pole. If you cut that in half, you have

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: two smaller magnets, each with its own north and south pole.

speaker: ira_flatow
text: Uh, Dr. Cooper, I think there might be something wrong with our connection.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: No, I hear you fine. As I was saying, an ordinary magnet has two poles. The primary characteristic of a monopole is that it has only one pole, hence, monopole. A requirement for string theory, or M-theory, if you will, is the existence of such monopoles. I, myself, led an expedition to the Arctic Circle in search of said particles. Kripke, I found the nozzle! I'm going to kill you!

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: So nice you could join me this evening. You're looking lovely as always.

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: Thanks, Howard. Always nice to be part of your masturbatory fantasies.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Come on, Katee, don't make it sound so cheap.

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: I'm sorry, fiddling with yourself in the bathtub is a real class act.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Thank you. So, shall we get started?

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: Sure. But can I ask you a question first?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You want to play Cylon and colonist?

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: No. I want to know why you're playing make-believe with me when you could be out with a real woman tonight.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: You mean, Bernadette?

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: No, I mean Princess Leia. Of course I mean Bernadette. She's a wonderful girl and she really likes you.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I know, but she's not you.

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: I'm not me. The real me is in Beverly Hills going out with a tall, handsome, rich guy. Six-four.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Really? Tall? Ouch.

speaker: katee_sackhoff
text: The point is, you've got a wonderful girl in your life, and you're ignoring her in order to spend your nights in the bathtub with a mental image and a wash cloth.

speaker: debbie_wolowitz
text: Howard! What are you doing in there?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I'm taking a bath!
